physics-e1-q2.prompt: E tinyere ihe mkpịsị ígwè n'ime iko plastik doro anya ma were magnet tụgharịa n'èzí iko ahụ. Gịnị ga-eme ihe mkpịsị ígwè ahụ mgbe a na-ebuli magnet nwayọọ gaa n'elu?

options.a: Ọ ga-eso magnet rịgoro n'elu n'akụkụ iko
options.d: Ọ ga-agbapụ n'akụkụ ọzọ site na magnet

hints: Ike magnet nwere ike ịgafe plastik ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ dị gịrịgịrị.
Mgbe magnet na-ebugharị, ihe mkpịsị ígwè na-eso ya.
physics-e1-q2.explanation: Ike magnet (magnetic force) nwere ike ịgafe ihe dị gịrịgịrị dị ka plastik, akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ iko ma rụọ ọrụ n'ihe e ji ígwè mee.

options.b: Mkpisi osisi na ihe a na-eji atụ ogologo plastik

hints: Chọta ihe ndị e ji ígwè mee.
Osisi, rabba na plastik adịghị arapara na magnet.
physics-e1-q3.explanation: E ji ígwè mee ntu ígwè na ihe mkpịsị ígwè, ya mere ha na-arapara nke ọma na magnet. Osisi, rabba, plastik na iko adịghị arapara na magnet.

options.a: Ike mkpali nke magnet dị na rabba mkpọchi

physics-e3-q4.prompt: A nyochara onyinyo ogwe ọkọlọtọ n'ogige egwuregwu n'ụbọchị doro anya: n'ụtụtụ na mgbede onyinyo dị ogologo nke ukwuu, na ehihie elekere 12 ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa. Gịnị mere?

physics-m2-c.prompt: [Nyocha circuit ọzọ] E jikọtara nguzogide 6 Ω na 3 Ω n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ma jikọọ ya na isi mmalite ike 12 V. Kedu ngụkọta ọkụ eletrik na-agafe circuit niile?

physics-killer-01.prompt: Otu ihe na-amalite site n'izu ike n'ebe A dị elu $50\,\mathrm{m}$ n'ụzọ roller coaster na-enweghị esemokwu. hints: Nchekwa ume nkà: $mg(h_A-h)=\frac12mv^2$, ya bụ $v=\sqrt{2g\,\Delta h}$ ($\Delta h$ bụ ịdị elu e si na A rịdata).

physics-killer-01.explanation: Ebe ihe ahụ na-ezu ike n'ebe A, site na $mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$ anyị nwere $v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$. $v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$, $v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$, $v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ya mere $v_C/v_B=2$ ugboro, $v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Ọsọ adabereghị n'ịdị elu e rịdatara n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ, ọ na-adabere na $\sqrt{\Delta h}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); ọ bụrụ na e were ịdị elu D $5\,\mathrm{m}$ dị ka ịdị elu e rịdatara, a ga-enweta $10\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ③); ọ bụrụ na e hapụ $\frac12$, a ga-enweta $\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ④).

physics-killer-02.prompt: Site n'ala ụzọ na-enweghị esemokwu (ịdị elu $0$) a jikọtara okirikiri kwụ ọtọ (loop) nwere radius $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. A chọrọ ịhapụ ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ site n'izu ike n'ụzọ ka ọ gaa gburugburu loop otu ugboro. Ọ bụrụ na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ịdị elu mmalite kacha ala $h_{min}$ (site n'ala) iji gafee elu loop na-ahapụghị ụzọ, na ike kwụ ọtọ $N$ ụzọ na-etinye n'ihe n'elu mgbe ịdị elu mmalite bụ $15\,\mathrm{m}$?

options.a: $8\,\mathrm{m}$, $50\,\mathrm{N}$

hints: N'elu $mg+N=\dfrac{mv^2}{R}$, ọnọdụ ịghara ịhapụ ụzọ bụ $N\ge0$, ya bụ $v_{top}\ge\sqrt{gR}$. Site na nchekwa ume $mgh=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$.
Ebe $v_{top}^2=gR=40$, $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{v_{top}^2}{2g}=8+2=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Ọ bụrụ na $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$ mgbe ahụ $v_{top}^2=2\cdot10\cdot(15-8)=140$.
physics-killer-02.explanation: Ọnọdụ kacha ala $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. Site na nchekwa ume $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$, $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Mgbe $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$, $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. Site na $mg+N=mv^2/R$, $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Iji naanị ịdị elu $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ pụtara na e hapụrụ ume mmegharị (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ pụtara na e leghaara ike ndọda anya (azịza na-ezighị ezi ②); $90\,\mathrm{N}$ bụ njehie akara nke ịgbakwunye ike ndọda (azịza na-ezighị ezi ③).
